This video draws on the National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine's 2024 workshop report on infection-associated chronic illness, and on Choutka, Jansari, Hornig, and Iwasaki's 2022 Nature Medicine review of unexplained post-acute infection syndromes, among the other peer-reviewed sources cited in the companion book chapter, Understanding Infection-Associated Chronic Illness. This is educational material, not medical advice.
